title: Diagnose Valentine Sales Growth and Mix
instructions: Analyze the provided store, chain, category, discount, profit, and calendar data. Determine whether the sales gain is most consistent with promotion, traffic, basket, or category mix; quantify the answer; state evidentiary limits; and recommend a measurable next-event action. Output: valentine_sales_diagnostic.md
criteria: Correctly separates traffic growth from basket decline.
Identifies Beauty and Accessories as the important mix movements.
Does not falsely attribute the gain to discounting.
